kapak.alt: Automated ABR for intensive care babies

youtube.baslik: Does a baby who passes OAE screening always hear well? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Screening with OAEs alone can pass a baby who has auditory neuropathy spectrum disorder, because OAEs do not show neural transmission. Guidelines recommend automated ABR screening for babies who stay in neonatal intensive care for more than five days.
youtube.kapanis_metni: Follow AIHEAR Audiology Academy for more quick facts.

instagram.kanca: Does a baby who passes OAE screening always hear well?
bilgiler: OAE-only screening can pass a baby with auditory neuropathy.
OAEs reflect outer hair cells, not neural transmission.
Babies in intensive care for over five days need automated ABR.
